q1_issues.issue: The object takes Theme, but the instruction set names call off / cancel over a scheduled occurrence (a flight is its own example) as altering the occurrence itself, so the role must be Patient.

notes: Phrasal verb kept whole as call_off with no genus, compound evening_flight with head genus only, and no status atom on the bare simple present are all as instructed. The object witness is named sk_flight_1 although its class is evening_flight, deviating from the sk_<class>_<n> convention without changing meaning.
